yharnam_dice.rules.title: Game rules
yharnam_dice.rules.free.roll: Choose 1 to %s dice from your pouch and press Throw. Roll again in any order.
yharnam_dice.rules.free.result: The table displays the rolled values. Agree on your own scoring and winner.
yharnam_dice.rules.poker.roll: Each player takes a turn rolling %s dice.
yharnam_dice.rules.poker.reroll: After the first round, mark dice to reroll or keep your hand. Rerolls per player: %s.
yharnam_dice.rules.poker.reroll_unknown: After the first round, reroll selected dice if the table allows it, or keep your hand.
yharnam_dice.rules.poker.win: The highest combination wins. Dice values break ties between combinations of the same rank. Identical hands tie.
yharnam_dice.rules.poker.ranks: Highest to lowest: five of a kind, four of a kind, full house, 2–6 straight, 1–5 straight, three of a kind, two pairs, pair, high die.
yharnam_dice.rules.farkle.goal: Start your turn by rolling %s dice. The first to reach %s points wins.
yharnam_dice.rules.farkle.roll: Start your turn by rolling %s dice. The first to reach the table's target wins.
yharnam_dice.rules.farkle.turn: Mark only scoring dice. Keep sets them aside for the turn, Throw rerolls the rest, and Bank adds your turn points to your total and passes play.
yharnam_dice.rules.farkle.bust: A roll with no scoring combination loses your unbanked points for the turn.
yharnam_dice.rules.farkle.hot: If all dice score, you can roll the full set again.
yharnam_dice.rules.farkle.no_hot: If all dice score, bank your points to end your turn.
yharnam_dice.rules.farkle.score: A single 1 scores 100, a 5 scores 50. Three 1s score 1000. Any other triple scores face value × 100. Each extra matching die doubles that combination. Straights 1–5, 2–6 and 1–6 score 500, 750 and 1500.
yharnam_dice.rules.twenty_one.generic: Roll %s dice at a time and add the sum to your score. Roll again or stand. The closest to the target without going over wins.
yharnam_dice.rules.twenty_one.roll: Each roll (%s dice) adds its sum to your score. Roll again or stand. Reaching exactly %s ends your turn.
yharnam_dice.rules.twenty_one.win: Going over %s is a bust. The player closest to %s without busting wins. Equal scores among remaining players tie.
yharnam_dice.rules.unique_dice: Every die in your selection must be a different type.
yharnam_dice.rules.host.transfer: If the host leaves, the next player takes over. The match ends if too few players remain.
yharnam_dice.rules.host.cancel: If the host leaves, the match ends without a winner.
yharnam_dice.rules.host.between_games: The host can leave the table between matches.
